```{r setup, include=FALSE}

```

```{r}
## Section 1 Introduction to Tourism Data

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)

#Here we will be exploring international tourism data from UN Tourism, here we can see a table with definitions of main variables 
## first i read the source file
tourism_data <- read_xlsx("data/raw/1._UN_Tourism_domestic_trips_12_2025.xlsx")
names(tourism_data)

tourism_domestic <- tourism_data |>
  select(indicator_code, reporter_area_label, year, value, flag)

tourism_domestic <- tourism_domestic |>
  rename(
    indicator        = indicator_code,
    country          = reporter_area_label,
    trips_thousands  = value
  )
names(tourism_domestic)

tourism_domestic <- tourism_domestic |>
  mutate(
    indicator = case_when(
      indicator == "DOMC_TRIP_TOTL_TOTL_VSTR" ~ "visitors",
      indicator == "DOMC_TRIP_TOTL_TOTL_TOUR" ~ "tourists",
      indicator == "DOMC_TRIP_TOTL_TOTL_EXCR" ~ "excursionists"
    ))
## now i am editing names of countries
tourism_domestic <- tourism_domestic |>
  mutate(
    country = case_when(
      country == "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland" ~ "United Kingdom",
      country == "United States of America"           ~ "United States",
      country == "Netherlands (Kingdom of the)"       ~ "Netherlands",
      country == "Iran (Islamic Republic of)"         ~ "Iran",
      country == "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)" ~ "Venezuela",
      country == "Republic of Korea"                  ~ "South Korea",
      country == "Republic of Moldova"                ~ "Moldova",
      country == "United Republic of Tanzania"        ~ "Tanzania",
      country == "Lao People's Democratic Republic"   ~ "Laos",
      country == "Democratic Republic of the Congo"   ~ "Congo",
      country == "Viet Nam"                           ~ "Vietnam",
      country == "Taiwan Province of China"                           ~ "Taiwan",
      country == "Côte d’Ivoire"                           ~ "Cote d Ivoire",
      TRUE ~ country  
    )                   
  )                     
#after cleaning the table i exported as a csv file
write_csv(tourism_domestic, here("data", "raw", "tourism_domestic.csv"))
sort(unique(tourism_domestic$country))
View(tourism_domestic$country)
tourism_domestic %>% distinct(country) %>% View()
```
